name: dump-analyzer
description: Post-mortem debugging of crash dumps in VS Code: Windows, Linux, and macOS minidumps and Linux core files, with every thread's stack, each frame's locals and registers (and where each value came from), memory, and disassembly. No debugger to install.

dump.description: The dump to open: a minidump (.dmp) or a core file.

symbols.description: Directories to look in for the dump's modules' images and debug information, besides the dump's own.

sysroot.description: Directories that stand for the dump's root, its modules' paths under them (a Linux system's files from Windows: \\wsl$\Ubuntu).

configurationSnippets.label: Dump Analyzer: open a crash dump

dumpAnalyzer.path.description: The dump-analyzer program to run (else the one the extension ships with, or dump-analyzer on the PATH).

dumpAnalyzer.symbolServers.description: Symbol servers with Microsoft's layout to fetch modules' images and debug information from (e.g. https://msdl.microsoft.com/download/symbols). Asking one tells it which builds the dump has.

dumpAnalyzer.debuginfod.description: debuginfod servers to fetch ELF modules' files from.

dumpAnalyzer.symbolCache.description: Where to keep what the servers send.
